collection.name: fatigueStresses
collection.doc: ⏳ Stress range of one fatigue detail from the fatigue load model (EN 1993-1-9 5.1 to 5.4): the stresses at the detail fibre from the member actions of the highest and the lowest load case, the reduction of the compressive part for non-welded or stress-relieved details, the geometric stress concentration, the plate thickness for the size effect and the number of cycles of the range.

fields.name: detail_id
fields.doc: 🔗 Id of the fatigue detail (category, method) the range belongs to.

fields.name: max_case_id
fields.doc: ⬆ Id of the load case whose member actions give the largest stress at the detail fibre (fatigue load model in its unfavourable position).

fields.name: min_case_id
fields.doc: ⬇ Id of the load case whose member actions give the smallest stress at the detail fibre.

fields.name: fibre_z
fields.doc: 📍 Distance z of the detail fibre from the y axis, positive in the direction of positive bending moment M_y compression: sigma = N/A + M_y z/I_y - M_z y/I_z.

fields.name: fibre_y
fields.doc: 📍 Distance y of the detail fibre from the z axis.

fields.name: relief
fields.doc: 🧯 As-welded details take the full range; stress-relieved welded and non-welded details take the compressive part of the cycle reduced (EN 1993-1-9 5.4).

enum.name: StressRelief
enum.doc: 🧯 Residual stress state of a fatigue detail: as welded, welded and stress relieved or non-welded.

fields.name: concentration
fields.doc: 📐 Geometric stress concentration factor k_f of the nominal stress at the detail (EN 1993-1-9 5.2); 0 = not given, the nominal stress is used unchanged.

fields.name: thickness
fields.doc: 📏 Thickness t of the cracked plate for the size effect k_s = (25/t)^n of the detail strength (EN 1993-1-9 7.1); 0 = not given, no size effect is applied.

fields.name: cycles
fields.doc: 🔁 Number of cycles of this stress range in the design life.
